rule.main_C2: 3-seed mean of (C2+P5 - C2): D_s <= -0.03 AND PSNR >= -0.15 dB -> pass (supports a capacity + exact observation layer design)
rule.large_candidate: 3-seed mean C2+P5 vs C0 base: PSNR >= +0.3 dB AND provisional QNR >= -0.005 -> flag as large-improvement candidate
rule.context: C0, C1, C3 with P5 and P0, and C2 with P0, are reported without separate gates
